credit: Subject and footage: the DreamCut owner, filmed by them and shown by their choice (2026-10-27). Effect inspired by a speed-effect tutorial by Marvin Appiah Korang.

footage.role: One locked-off take: an empty path, then the owner walking between six stops toward the camera, a spoken line, and walking off (29.5 s shown, 48 s filmed)

teachingNote: Normal speed; holds of 3 frames, takeoff streaks of 2 frames, the line from 2.0 s and the exit streak at 7.1 s.

receipt.construction: DreamCut project new-storyboard-02e21080 after the owner applied its speed-hop, exit and sound cards, rendered 0-7.6 s with the production browser GPU compositor (scripts/render-preview.ts, scale 0.6667) through an unposted proposal file that removes the captions, then H.264 CRF 28 without audio (the hop sounds come from a third-party tutorial with no documented redistribution right). Poster at 2.6 s; stages at 0.05, 0.25, 3.0 and 7.13 s. The supplied take is 15.0-44.5 s of the original, 480x854. The prepared cut-out is frame 3 of SAM 2 cut-out e91a3c13 (source 44.0-44.3 s).
